risk_note: CT-06zzzzzd (FU-REPLAY-TEARDOWN-57P01; 编排 D10-1453 chose (B)). Change only in packages/db/src/testing/index.ts (+ packages/db/README.md): the test-database drop() now polls pg_stat_activity (datname = the database, pid <> pg_backend_pid(), every 25 ms) on the factory connection and waits up to DROP_GRACE_MS = 3000 ms for other backends to exit on their own before DROP DATABASE ... WITH (FORCE); with none left the first poll drops at once; still connected after the grace limit they are terminated by FORCE and receive 57P01 as before. No error is swallowed and no ignoring error listener is attached. Cause (be 11-13 18:3x): pg-pool end() resolves after calling client.end() without waiting for the socket to close, so the immediate FORCE drop killed backends still exiting and their FATAL 57P01 landed on a pool nobody listened to (3 unhandled errors in replay/qa-03b on main 0bea8205 verify-replay). Rule tests (Codex): container red red/1 PASS (#1 got 57P01, #2 dropped after 4 ms < 1000 ms); after the implementation the same --red path red/2 runs both green. Test tooling only; no production path, no money / attribution code.
